title: Light String Winders 10-Pack – Keep Your Christmas Lights Organized
seo_title: Light String Winders 10-Pack – Order for Your Christmas Lights
seo_description: 10 black plastic winders keep each string of lights separate. Half-moon-shaped ends and a handle hole to hang them up.
descriptionHtml:
The cord pile is waiting before Christmas is even over

Every January the light strings go into a box as one single clump, and next year the decorating starts with twenty minutes of untangling instead of hanging something up.

10 winders that keep each string separate

Ten winders in black plastic with half-moon-shaped ends that hold the cord in place, and a handle hole to hang them by. Each string of lights gets its own winder instead of being mixed up with the others.

Features

  • 10 winders in the pack – one for each string of lights, nobody has to share
  • Each string of lights is wound separately – kept apart from the others in storage
  • Half-moon-shaped ends hold the cord in place – it doesn't slip off in storage
  • Handle holes make them easy to hang up – on a hook instead of in a box
  • Black plastic that can stay in the box all year – ready to use again next Christmas
